scripts.dev: npm run compile && concurrently --kill-others "dotnet fickl watch Playground.fsproj --outDir generated --configuration Release" "vite --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev:test: concurrently --kill-others "dotnet fickl watch Playground.fsproj --outDir generated --configuration Release" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5178 --strictPort"
scripts.test:dom: npm run compile:tests -- --define RANVIER_VIEW_COUNTERS && node --test tests/dom.test.mjs tests/scheduled.test.mjs tests/lifetime.test.mjs tests/representation.test.mjs tests/component.test.mjs tests/binding.test.mjs tests/mounting-investigation.test.mjs tests/template-catalogue.test.mjs tests/owned-async.test.mjs tests/integration.test.mjs tests/unsafe-html.test.mjs tests/document.test.mjs tests/server.test.mjs tests/hydration.test.mjs tests/sugar-server.test.mjs tests/sugar-emit.test.mjs tests/sugar.test.mjs tests/sugar-release.test.mjs tests/elmish-nested.test.mjs tests/sugar-rows.test.mjs tests/departures.test.mjs tests/pending-regions.test.mjs benchmarks/frameworks/gates.test.mjs tests/conformance.test.mjs tests/conformance-diff.test.mjs tests/conformance-host.test.mjs
scripts.test:sugar-debug: npm run compile:tests && dotnet fickl tests/DomTests.fsproj --outDir generated-tests-debug --configuration Debug && node --test tests/sugar-debug.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run compile:tests && npm run compile && playwright test
scripts.test: npm run test:dom && npm run test:sugar-debug && npm run test:sugar-counters && npm run test:browser
